Hero.title: Hi! I'm Javier Vega Molina
Hero.content: Software Developer with experience in creating scalable and modern applications

Skills.title: Services & Skills
Skills.content: I provide end-to-end solutions for web applications, from design and development to deployment, optimization, monitoring and ongoing maintenance. I help businesses improve their digital presence, build reliable systems, and launch fast, secure websites with custom domains and business email.

FrontEnd.title: Frontend Development
FrontEnd.content: Designing and building modern, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces optimized for all devices. I create fast, accessible, and pixel-perfect web experiences using the latest frontend technologies.

BackEnd.title: Backend Development
BackEnd.content: Developing secure, scalable, and high-performance server-side solutions. I build REST APIs, microservices, database architectures, background jobs (Cron, schedulers), and AI-powered features using modern backend frameworks.

Maintenance.title: Maintenance & Monitoring
Maintenance.content: Providing continuous support, bug fixing, performance optimization, and new feature development. I implement monitoring tools to keep your systems healthy, stable, and running efficiently.

SoftwareTest.title: Software Testing
SoftwareTest.content: Creating automated test suites, including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. I also design stress and load testing scenarios to ensure system reliability at scale.

PerformanceDigitalPresence.title: Performance & Digital Presence
PerformanceDigitalPresence.content: Improving website speed, SEO ranking, accessibility, and conversion rates. I support business growth through technical SEO, analytics, marketing funnels, and lead-capture strategies.

WebHosting.title: Web Hosting
WebHosting.content: Setting up secure hosting solutions with custom domains, SSL certificates, DNS configurations, and business email accounts. Fully managed deployment and hosting for your website or application.

About.title: About
About.content: Get to know more about my background and skills

MainInfo.title: Who I am
MainInfo.content_1: I'm Javier Vega, a Software Engineer from Guayaquil, Ecuador. I hold a Bachelor's in Computer Science from ESPOL and a Master's in Artificial Intelligence from UEES.
MainInfo.content_2: Today I work at Banco Bolivariano, building banking services and integrations on AWS with Java and Spring Boot — from a phonetic search with OpenSearch that cut remittance cancellations by 50% to real-time interbank payments through BANRED.
MainInfo.content_3: Before that, I spent over two years at Telecu, where I grew from Junior to Semi-Senior full-stack developer building RAG chatbots, AI agents, voice bots and billing integrations with TypeScript, NestJS, React and Python.
MainInfo.content_4: I focus on dependable, well-tested systems and on practical uses of AI that solve real business problems.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.content: A selection of my recent work: products built at work, freelance projects and personal side projects.

DataProtectionAssistant.title: Data Protection Law AI Assistant
DataProtectionAssistant.summary: A conversational AI agent that makes Ecuador's Data Protection Law accessible to everyone, with accurate, citation-backed answers.
DataProtectionAssistant.highlight_1: Designed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture with LangChain and OpenAI that grounds every answer in the text of the law to prevent hallucinations.
DataProtectionAssistant.highlight_2: Added a semantic router to optimize LLM costs and a ChromaDB vector database for document ingestion.
DataProtectionAssistant.highlight_3: Delivered multi-channel access through a React web interface and WhatsApp.

Daule.title: Electronic Services Portal — Daule
Daule.summary: The digital government portal of the Municipality of Daule, serving 200,000+ residents.
Daule.highlight_1: Built a high-traffic frontend with React and TypeScript, focused on stability and accessibility for critical public services.
Daule.highlight_2: Implemented a rigorous end-to-end testing strategy with Cypress, reaching 95% code coverage.
Daule.highlight_3: Integrated the test suite into a Jenkins CI/CD pipeline to ensure zero-failure releases.

DeveloperTools.title: Developer Tools
DeveloperTools.summary: A fast, private toolbox for developers: format, convert, compare and validate JSON, XML, SQL and more, right in the browser.
DeveloperTools.highlight_1: Every tool runs 100% client-side: no uploads, no accounts and no server, so sensitive data never leaves the user's tab.
DeveloperTools.highlight_2: 10 tools live — JSON, XML and SQL formatters, a JWT decoder, text diff, timestamp converter and more — with 19 more on the roadmap.
DeveloperTools.highlight_3: Static Astro pages with almost no JavaScript, in English and Spanish, with a command palette, keyboard shortcuts and light/dark themes.

Zentinel.title: Zentinel
Zentinel.summary: An access control platform that streamlines visitor registration and management for residential communities, companies and schools.
Zentinel.highlight_1: Developed features across the platform's React frontend and NestJS backend, with Keycloak authentication and PostgreSQL.
Zentinel.highlight_2: Built the product's landing page with Astro and Tailwind, walking visitors through the workflow, key features and use cases.

Hermes.title: Hermes
Hermes.summary: A platform that places conversational phone calls powered by generative AI, with natural, personalized interactions in real time.
Hermes.highlight_1: Automates customer service, surveys and virtual-assistant flows over the phone.
Hermes.highlight_2: Built on React and NestJS with PostgreSQL, secured with Keycloak and deployed with Docker.

GpaCalculator.title: ESPOL GPA Calculator
GpaCalculator.summary: A simple tool that helps ESPOL students estimate their GPA from the grades they enter and try different scenarios.
GpaCalculator.highlight_1: Built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and open source on GitHub.
